get.description: This endpoint allows the authenticated user to retrieve a list of their own notifications. The system uses the bearer token from the Authorization header to identify the user making the request and returns only notifications that belong to them. Each notification entry includes information such as the event type, delivery method (e.g., app, SMS, email), message content, creation timestamp, and read status. This endpoint is typically used to display a user’s notification inbox or alert panel.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to define a new permission using an HTTP POST request. The request body must include the action, resource, access type, and permission string. This permission can then be assigned to roles.

get.description: This endpoint fetches a specific permission by its ID, returning all permission attributes.

delete.description: This endpoint deletes a permission by ID. Deletion is restricted if the permission is linked to any role or user type.

get.description:
Retrieves a list of all API keys in the system. Each entry includes the key's UUID and the role it is assigned to.

Requires the `view:apikeys` permission.

post.description:
Creates a new API key. The key is scoped to the operator derived from the authenticated user's token and assigned to the specified role.

The `created_by` field is resolved automatically from the authenticated user's token and do not need to be supplied in the request body.

The `expiry_date` must be a future date and no more than 2 years from the current date.

Requires the `create:apikeys` permission.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes the API key with the given numeric ID. Once deleted, any integrations using this key will lose access immediately.

Requires the `delete:apikeys` permission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the API key to delete.
